name: Simi Mini A 2026

venue.name: Simi Valley Public Library
venue.address: 2969 Tapo Canyon Road, Simi Valley, CA

information:
### This competition is held in series with [Simi Mini B 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SimiMiniB2026)! You can only compete in one of these competitions!

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SimiMiniA2026#17574-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
